descriptionPlain: Voltus is seeking an innovative Project Engineer to join our Field Operations Team, supporting our continued growth. This remote role requires a detail-oriented professional capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously and engaging in high-level technical discussions with customers. Our team is dedicated to maximizing customer participation in demand response programs through expert load curtailment strategies and proprietary hardware enablement.

lists.content:
• Project Leadership: Manage end-to-end installation execution projects, including metering and product enablement. Maintain hardware throughout life-cycle

  • Technical Strategy: Provide technical support to the Sales team and assist customers with energy reduction strategies.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Engage with Engineering to develop hardware and innovative metering solutions.

  • Process Improvement: Define and optimize processes to enhance efficiency and accelerate installation timelines.

  • Compliance: Ensure all materials, installations, and technologies meet rigorous industry and market standards.

• Education: Bachelor in Engineering/Technical related field or relevant work experience

  • Work Experience: 2 years with Bachelor or 6+ years relevant work experience 

  • Core Competencies: Results-driven, analytical, and highly motivated team player with exceptional communication and customer service skills.

  • Technical Expertise: Experience in hardware commissioning, troubleshooting, data platform integration, and contractor management.

  • Software Proficiency: Experience with Salesforce.

  • Preferred Skills: PMP certification; background in electrical, HVAC, or industrial controls, energy storage, energy efficiency, data analysis; proficiency in reading/drawing electrical schematics.

salaryDescription: Base pay is $80,000-$90,000 annually, commensurate with experience, with 10% bonus paid annually, and equity. In addition to a competitive compensation package, Voltus offers a range of benefits including: unlimited leave for full-time employees, parental leave, and a comprehensive benefits package to promote health, wellness, and financial security.
